theorem putnam_1964_a4
(u : ℕ → ℤ)
(boundedu : ∃ B T : ℤ, ∀ n : ℕ, B ≤ u n ∧ u n ≤ T)
(hu : ∀ n ≥ 4, u n = ((u (n - 1) + u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) * u (n - 4)) : ℝ) / (u (n - 1) * u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) + u (n - 4)) ∧ (u (n - 1) * u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) + u (n - 4)) ≠ 0)
: (∃ N c : ℕ, c > 0 ∧ ∀ n ≥ N, u (n + c) = u n) := by
  obtain ⟨B, T, hB⟩ := boundedu
  let s := Icc B T
  let f := fun n => (u n, u (n+1), u (n+2), u (n+3))
  have hs : s.Finite := Set.finite_Icc B T
  obtain ⟨i, j, hij, h_eq⟩ := Set.Finite.exists_lt_map_eq_of_forall_mem (t := s ×ˢ s ×ˢ s ×ˢ s) (f := f)
    (fun n => ⟨hB n, hB (n+1), hB (n+2), hB (n+3)⟩) (hs.prod (hs.prod (hs.prod hs)))
  have hd : ∀ a b : ℕ, f a = f b → u (a+4) = u (b+4) := by
    intro a b h
    simp only [f, Prod.mk.injEq] at h
    rw [← Int.cast_inj (α := ℝ), (hu (a+4) (by omega)).1, (hu (b+4) (by omega)).1]
    simp [h]
  have key : ∀ m : ℕ, f (i+m) = f (j+m) := by
    intro m
    induction m with
    | zero => exact h_eq
    | succ m ih =>
      have h4 := hd (i+m) (j+m) ih
      simp only [f, Prod.mk.injEq] at ih ⊢
      exact ⟨ih.2.1, ih.2.2.1, ih.2.2.2, h4⟩
  refine ⟨i, j - i, by omega, fun n hn => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le hn
  rw [show i + m + (j - i) = j + m by omega]
  exact (congrArg Prod.fst (key m)).symm
